mathematical_dependency: The all-length proof accepts the stated original unrestricted necessity lemmas of Min-Park2006 and proves converses, inverse restrictions, multiplicities and uniqueness in full. It does not use Min2021 Theorem2.7.

standard_analytic_reference.title: Flajolet and Sedgewick, Analytic Combinatorics (2009), Chapter VI
standard_analytic_reference.role: Standard algebraic-singularity transfer; all model-specific analytic hypotheses are established in Report149.

earlier_corroborating_checks.description: Separate direct involution enumeration using strict value-adjacency and positional-vincular predicates, through original length22. This receipt is not the fresh packaged companion run.

limitations: Finite computation is not the all-length proof.
No global novelty claim or exhaustive literature review.
Inverse bracket constants and onsets are asymptotic existence constants, not effective finite-input certificates.
No external publication, submission, author contact, or repository edit.

bounded_equivalence_search.result: No matching OEIS entry or explicit corrected enumeration located in the bounded searches. This is not a novelty certificate.
related_sources_distinguished: BHV2008 general algebraicity applies, but separate examples for alternating separable permutations and separable involutions are not joint-class formulas.
Barnabei2023 Section10 identifies the class and cites Min; it does not independently repair the recurrence.
Dilks2014 alternating Baxter symmetry under conjugation by w0 is reverse-complement, not inversion.
